text:
Bitcoin reclaimed the $76,000 mark after a 20% weekly surge, powered by over $1.3 billion in net inflows across U.S. spot ETFs, including $307.5 million in a single session. Regulatory tailwinds strengthened as the White House urged Congress to pass the Clarity Act, while the SEC advanced tailored crypto offering frameworks.

Macro liquidity provided fresh momentum following the U.S. Treasury's decision to double long-dated bond buybacks, pushing benchmark yields lower. With the Federal Reserve holding rates at 3.50%–3.75% ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium, softening Treasury yields and an easing dollar are driving institutional capital across risk assets. This retreat in real rates reinforces the correlation between equity momentum and crypto liquidity, accelerating digital asset allocation across institutional portfolios.
